requests.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Make ONE VERY SMALL, PRECISE revision to this OWN-PROJECT enemy comparison sheet. The owner approved the purple ogre and hero and wants the ORC just a little smaller than this version.
CHANGE ONLY ORC SCALE: uniformly reduce the entire ORC figure, including axe/clothing/hair/body, by approximately7–8% relative to current Image1. Anchor each orc at the SAME foot-contact baseline so he stands on the same ground, not floating. Do this BOTH to the large left orc in the main parchment row and to the small left orc in the lower grassy tactical strip. Do not selectively shrink the head/arms, do not redesign anatomy, pose, outfit or face. He must remain noticeably taller and broader than the hero, with the resulting size midway between our earlier small and current large version. Keep the existing smoke-olive skin, rusty-red cloth, iron shoulder plate and axe, all exactly the same design.
PRESERVE EVERYTHING ELSE AS CLOSELY AS POSSIBLE: hero in center EXACT same size/appearance/position; approved violet-purple ogre at right EXACT same size, skin color, pose, straps and wooden club in BOTH rows. Preserve parchment, grass, perspective, lighting, labels «ОРК», «ГЕРОЙ», «ОГР», margins and overall sheet composition. Do not scale down the whole sheet or change hero size to fake the reduction. No new UI, text, characters, content or fantasy redesign. One completed landscape comparison concept.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE WIDE, CLEAR PLACEMENT CONCEPT showing WHERE our approved temple mage stands in our EXISTING fantasy city beside its temple and teleport seal. This is an enlarged tactical-camera view of the temple quarter, not a new city design, character sheet, map UI or claim of implemented gameplay.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image1 is OUR OWN already-approved and implemented city architecture/layout reference. Focus on its quiet pale-stone TEMPLE at the LEFT EDGE of the city and its flat silver/cyan ornamental GROUND TELEPORT SEAL in the adjacent paved courtyard. Image2 is OUR OWN APPROVED mage v2 design plus an example courtyard vignette. Use ONLY that approved long-haired silver-bearded cleric with ivory/plum/gold ceremonial robe, closed book, cross-shaped gold staff; no outfit, face or staff redesign.
COMPOSITION: a single immersive landscape game-camera view, elevated orthographic 3/4 matching our illustrated isometric sprite game. Enlarge the ENTIRE COURTYARD, not the individual NPC. Show the whole existing modest temple in upper left, including roof, pale masonry walls, small rose window, wooden doorway and steps. Full circular ground teleport seal lies separately at lower-right in this same courtyard; preserve its original position beside the temple, decorative pattern and flat ground perspective. Do not put the portal inside the temple or on its steps.
At the right/lower edge show the OPEN COURTYARD EXIT leading to the existing cobblestone town street and a little of the original orange-roof housing/stonewall/timber fence context so the location within the city is clear. Include only existing garden/flower/lantern dressing as seen in Image1, no new shrine, cathedral, altars, monuments, service stalls, portal arch or additional building.
NPC PLACEMENT: the approved mage v2 stands on the free paving BESIDE the temple entrance steps, off the direct door axis, OUTSIDE the teleport rings. Clearly separated from facade and portal, with at least one hero-body width of clear paving around him. Show one unchanged blue-coated hero C a few steps away on approach from the street. Mage body approximately same human height as hero, staff rises above the head only by its finial. Both figures share ground/camera, no oversized foreground priest. Long white hair/beard, ceremonial ivory/plum/gold robe and cross staff remain legible at this enlarged courtyard view.
WALKABILITY: clearly open direct routes STREET→MAGE, STREET→PORTAL CENTER, PORTAL→TEMPLE DOOR, with neither figure standing on the seal center or blocking the doorway. Full robe hem, foot contact, entire staff and full portal circumference visible with safe margins. Grounding shadows agree with the same lighting.
STYLE: match Image1's soft painted fantasy volumes, clean contour, matte textures, cream stone/orange terracotta and green garden colors; the approved mage matches hero C painted proportions. Dangerous fantasy game's calm inhabited refuge, not photorealistic architecture or anime. Preserve ordinary human/building scale. No huge bloom, mist hiding paths, giant light beam, crowds, UI, quest icons, arrows, labels, text or inset panels. Original project concept art.
